experiences.fullDescription:
• Built a live sports-commentary pipeline on Apache Kafka that turns raw game events into a full audio-visual broadcast.
• Made it 73% faster by letting audio and video run in parallel and reusing match state between turns.
• Wrote the stage that stitches AI-generated video back to its voice, frame by frame, down to the exact slice of audio.
• Taught a Gemma model to actually watch the match: live game state and emotion cues cut bad output by 80%. A goal gets a roar; a throw-in gets a shrug.
• Swapped ElevenLabs for a self-hosted Dia voice model and brought video generation in-house: cheaper per call, and one less network hop mid-broadcast.
• Picked the GPUs (which ones, how many, how they're arranged) to run it all on a fixed budget.
• Designed the "director's switch" that picks what viewers see: commentary, the leaderboard, or the crowd losing it.
• Locked down the inference fleet with TOTP 2FA and rotating JWTs, and kept our GPU box humming.

• Built Spring Boot microservices for HP's Workforce Experience Platform, the thing enterprises use to wrangle thousands of devices scattered across the globe.
• Folded a sprawl of REST endpoints into one GraphQL API on AWS: 35% less complexity.
• Helped design the Standard-to-Elite subscription tiers, with an estimated 28% bump in adoption to show for it.
• Made alerts land where people actually look: per-tenant Slack and Teams widgets that cut response times by 45%.
• Kept HP's Go translation service fluent in 20+ languages, and automated its string syncing across five services.
• Chased a mysterious cross-environment login failure down to an HTTP header size limit, then caught it again when a redeploy quietly undid the fix.
• Wired Trivy, Veracode and SonarQube into CI, then fixed what they flagged.
• Cleaned up Maven dependency management and builds, cutting deployment cycles by about 40%.
• Juggled three teams at once: platform, subscriptions and localization.

• Rebuilt HP TechPulse's reporting so IT teams could see fleet health and fix devices before they broke.
• Piped telemetry through AWS Kinesis and Redshift: reporting got 65% more efficient.
• Hooked into Windows WMI events for real-time updates, taking latency from 60 ms to under 17 ms.
• Built custom integrations on the AWS QuickSight API for dashboards that scale across the enterprise.
• Crunched millions of telemetry data points into structured analytics.
• That data fed maintenance strategies that cut support escalations.
• Found savings projected at $250,000 a year for enterprise clients, through smarter device lifecycle management.

• Went digging through SQL Server execution plans and untangled multi-table joins: billing runs got 40% faster.
• Built a Python ETL framework that pulls billing data from multiple upstream systems.
• It wiped out 95% of manual billing corrections along the way.
• Put the billing pipelines on Apache Airflow with SLA-aware schedules, live monitoring and alerts.
• Set up CI/CD with Git, Jenkins and Airflow, so dev and prod stopped drifting apart.
• Wrote Linux scripts that spot failing jobs early and automate the logs: 78% fewer failed billing runs.
• Scaled billing on AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda) to take 3x the peak traffic while spending 30% less.

• Helped RK Vaishnavi Academy move its whole classroom online in 2020.
• Ran Google Workspace, the Admin Console and YouTube Studio behind the scenes.
• Organized online events and kept the learning platform ticking.
• Planned the academy's tech setup with the founding director.
• Edited lecture and event videos in Premiere Pro.
• Made the learning materials and presentations look the part.

• Trained TensorFlow models on COVID-19 data in the thick of 2020.
• Feature engineering made the trend predictions 35% more accurate.
• Dug through case data for transmission hotspots and risk patterns.
• Built time-series models to predict regional outbreaks.
• Built FBProphet forecast dashboards to spot emerging hotspots and plan resources ahead.
• Turned the numbers into plain answers for epidemiologists and public-health officials.

• Designed a Depression Coping Service from scratch.
• Brought in training from IIT Bombay's Education Research cell.
• Turned research on mental-health interventions into an actual system design.
• Mapped out the user flows and the architecture.
• Put engagement front and center, so the platform keeps people coming back.
• Grounded it all in evidence-based support for people managing depression.

• Wrangled medical-device data into HL7 with Python, so different monitoring systems could finally talk to each other.
• Wrote algorithms that turn raw physiological sensor readings into something doctors can act on.
• Built a real-time pipeline that made patient monitoring 28% more accurate.
• Added validation that catches bad sensor readings before they reach anyone.
• Sat with clinicians to learn their workflows, then turned them into specs for the data dashboards.

• Segmented images without supervision by mixing wavelet transforms with clustering.
• Beat the established methods by 20% on accuracy.
• Built adaptive mask filters in MATLAB that tune themselves to each image.
• Got sharper edges and features, even on images where the traditional methods fell over.
• Benchmarked everything against the standard techniques on precision and speed.
• Worked with senior researchers through round after round of feedback, sharpening the approach each time.
